build_s3_storage_service: build a python module using S3StorageService to read and write files to an S3 bucket
copy_s3_files: create a python script to copy files between S3 buckets or from local storage to S3 recursively
upload_download_dirs: build a python module to upload a local directory to S3 or download an S3 directory locally
review_s3_file_info: review the S3StorageService get_file_info method to retrieve last modified time and file size
list_s3_files: create a python script to list all files recursively in an S3 directory using list_files
